name: Germany
note: My first overseas trip after the pandemic was a ten-day school tour to Germany and Austria. Half the time was spent on the road, but I've since fallen in love with the picturesque and laid-back towns. The food was, in fact, better than expected.

berlin-reichstag.jpg.alt: The columned façade of Berlin's Reichstag, partly framed by a leafy tree beneath a blue sky.

munich-nationaltheater.jpg.alt: Munich's Nationaltheater with pink and purple lighting on its columns, sculpted pediments and a rooftop flag beneath grey clouds.

nuremberg-lake.jpg.alt: Purple wildflowers and reeds along a lake in Nuremberg, with a tree-lined far shore under grey clouds.

nuremberg-rooftops.jpg.alt: Red-tiled rooftops and half-timbered houses in Nuremberg, with green church spires rising above the old town.

nuremberg-st-lorenz-church.jpg.alt: The ornate rose window and carved Gothic stonework on the façade of St. Lorenz Church in Nuremberg.
